Style: cinematic 3D CG rendering with a contemporary Chinese urban interior aesthetic, realistic PBR materials, refined fabric and hair simulation, and a restrained palette of dark wood brown, blue-black, moon-white, cinnabar red, antique gold, and low-value gray. The scene is set at night inside a modern Chinese-style study on the third floor of a large residence in a fictional city. A half-open wooden door and its frame create a foreground frame-within-a-frame, leading the eye into a dim room dominated by a central desk, a seated figure, a full-height book wall, and a gridded window overlooking blurred city lights. The camera uses a medium, slightly elevated doorway angle, with shallow depth of field and warm low-key illumination.

In the center, an East Asian man in his late twenties to early thirties sits alone at the desk, shown from about mid-thigh upward. He has a slim-to-average build, fair-to-medium skin with realistic subsurface scattering, short black hair parted loosely with natural volume, straight brows, a defined jawline, and a serious, inward-looking expression. His face is partly lit by the brass desk lamp and partly held in shadow, giving him a guarded, calculating presence. He wears a dark navy or charcoal traditional-inspired Chinese jacket with a Mandarin collar, frog-button closures, subtle woven texture, and matte fine-grain fabric. His posture is hunched forward over paperwork, one hand holding a pen near documents while the other rests close to the ledger, suggesting accounting, investigation, or private record-keeping.

The desk occupies the lower middle of the composition and is made of polished reddish-brown wood with visible grain, worn drawer edges, and a circular pale water stain where a cup has been placed repeatedly. On the left side of the desktop, a brass banker-style lamp with a rounded dome shade casts a warm 3000K pool of light across paper, leather-bound books, and small desk objects. Near the lamp are stacked books with aged covers, a small glass or metal container, and scattered writing tools. At the front-right corner of the desk lies an old black-and-white portrait photograph under or beside an ID badge, showing a uniformed person in formal attire; this object becomes a visual anchor tied to memory, duty, or unresolved history. Across the center of the desk are open ledgers, loose forms, handwritten sheets, and accounting pages with visible fibers and soft shadows. 采用并排分屏构图方式，画面从左至右严格划分为四个独立面板：第一面板为角色面部精细特写肖像；第二面板为正面全身站立姿势；第三面板为侧面全身站立姿势；第四面板为背面全身站立姿势（背部清晰可见）。所有面板统一采用中性浅灰色或米白色工作室背景，照明均匀柔和，模拟专业摄影棚布光，无强烈阴影或色温差异。四个视图中头身比例、肢体长度、服装细节及褶皱走向必须严格保持一致，确保比例和透视准确无误。最终成片不得包含任何文字、标志、水印或标签，保持画面干净专业。
极度艺术化的波普艺术画作，强烈的金属感和未来感，赛博朋克风格的女性主角，精致的详细的文字

· 风格：电影级 3D CG 渲染，东方国风美学，当代都市新中式基调，写实唯美，PBR 物理材质，细腻布料与毛发解算，东方古典色彩（黛青 / 朱砂 / 月白 / 鎏金）作情绪撞色，低明度高级灰打底，柔光与体积光，电影级景深，高精度建模，真实皮肤质感（次表面散射），非卡通夸张比例
· 时代：现代都市 · 当下（虚构 A 市）
· 时段：夜（主）/ 午后
· 空间：室内
· 场景描述：比例 9:16，3D CG 渲染的新中式大宅三楼书房。一面顶天立地的书墙（红木格栅 + 少量精装书与大量空档），中央一张一体式书桌，桌后是一扇中式木格窗。色彩体系取暖木褐 + 鸦青，低照度。核心材质：红木（油润、木纹清晰）、皮质椅面（哑光细纹）、黄铜台灯（拉丝 + 高光）、宣纸与账册（纤维可见）、玻璃杯（折射）。使用痕迹：桌面左角有一圈常年放杯留下的浅色水印；书桌第二层抽屉边缘磨得发白；桌角压着一张旧照片，照片上的人挂着工牌。机位从门口稍高角度收入整体空间，前景为半开的门扇与门框（框中框），中景是书桌与坐姿人物，后景是书墙与窗，窗外是城市夜景的散点灯火。
· 光照氛围：夜段以桌上一盏黄铜台灯为单点主光（3000K，硬质小光源），窗外城市光作冷侧逆补光；光比 6:1，人物半张脸在阴影里；窗帘把窗格影子投在书墙与地面上（帘影投屏）；空气中有极淡的浮尘粒子。情绪：私密、压着、算账。
· 镜头角度：中景平视为主（叙事）；大全景俯视（从门口上方）用于"被审视 / 被看穿"时刻。
· 视觉锚点：桌角那张挂工牌的旧照片 + 那盏黄铜台灯。
